rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that was true at some time in the past.

example.english: I formerly worked at this company.
example.traditional: 我以前喺呢間公司做嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 hai2 ne1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 je5

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone or something once had a past status or experience, such as formerly being known by another name.

example.english: This shop was formerly known by another name.
example.traditional: 呢間舖曾經叫另一個名。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 cang4 ging1 giu3 ling6 jat1 go3 meng2

rows.note: Use this for a more old-fashioned or nostalgic reference to earlier times rather than a specific former status.

example.english: People formerly often sang together during Lunar New Year.
example.traditional: 從前啲人過年成日一齊唱歌。
example.jyutping: cung4 cin4 di1 jan4 gwo3 nin4 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 coeng3 go1
